target: Arquitectura exterior del asentamiento secundario Alto de las Raíces, transición Nhal/Hoshai.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: ARCHITECTURE / SETTLEMENT — NO CREATURE. Refugio pequeño de montaña y bosque para descanso antes del ascenso y circulación de noticias entre ambas regiones.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: ARCHITECTURE / SETTLEMENT — NO CREATURE. Create a wide exterior architectural scene of Alto de las Raíces. A very small traveler refuge occupies a stable shelf where huge Nhal roots give way to exposed Hoshai stone and steeper ascent. A few compact weather-resistant shelters use timber and local stone without cutting away the dominant roots. Include a protected rest/work area and a clearly continuing uphill route. Forest shade remains below while colder open mountain light begins above. Modest, practical, integrated with terrain.
negative_constraints: No mountain village, monastery, fortress or temple
No carved stairs, monumental gates or invented symbols
No magical roots, glowing lantern spectacle or runes
No characters or creatures as focal subject
notes: Asentamiento secundario canónico; refugio de transición, no pueblo principal.
